source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Understanding Cyber Threats under 9.2 as printed (PDF 126, printed 122).

blocks.text: Cyber threats are actions or programs that target computers and networks to cause harm. These include stealing information, damaging systems, or interrupting online services. Understanding how threats work helps users recognize early warning signs. Most attacks can be avoided by safe browsing, using antivirus software, and being cautious with emails and links. Recognizing threats is the first step toward protecting digital systems.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Phishing is among the most common attacks.
